verdict.rationale: Godot is a game engine, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. Runtime probes on two dates found no official MCP server: a GitHub search of the godotengine org for 'mcp' returned 0 results, and the Asset Library has no MCP entries. The MCP servers that do exist (e.g. Coding-Solo/godot-mcp, hi-godot/godot-ai) are community projects, and the built-in GDScript language server is LSP, not MCP, so neither satisfies the story.
